tier_reason: Reversible HQ code and record changes; verified by tests and repository history before completion.
source_message: Daniel asked whether the 19 cards should be handled once or by the system. Adam chose both: reconcile the historical records, then make HQ handle the lifecycle automatically.
title: Make HQ close finished work and return incomplete work automatically
ask: Replace the inferred completion bucket with an explicit lifecycle. A recorded result must say whether it completed, a checker must verify it with no unresolved findings, tier-1 evidence must match the applied diff and commit, and only then may HQ record landing and file current follow-ups. One repair returns to the same owner; a second failure or blocked dependency is held with a concrete reason. Every Queue view must consume the same status.
first_action: Add the explicit outcome, verification, repair and landing contract with regression tests for incomplete attempts, concerns, stale evidence, duplicate follow-ups and failed commits.
